companies.name: IGI - Izaki Group Investments
companies.quote: Ron Izaki serves as CEO of IGI - Izaki Group Investments and is closely involved in all aspects of the team's real estate investments and development activities across Eastern Europe and other territories, including Israel and the United States.

companies.name: Brack Real Estate
companies.quote: In addition to his role as CEO of the IGI, Mr. Izaki is also a director of Brack Real Estate, an international owner, developer and manager of large-scale real estate assets in multiple countries in Europe, USA and the Middle East.

companies.name: Brack Capital Group
companies.quote: Mr. Izaki was a founder of the Brack Capital Group, which was established in 1992, and has been involved with the Brack Capital Group's extensive real estate activities; its infrastructure and energy related projects, as well as venture capital investments, since the group's very inception.

companies.name: ATLAS PLC
companies.quote: Mr. Izaki is also the major shareholder of ATLAS PLC a public company trading in the AIM and invests in yield producing assets and develops residential, offices and retail projects in Central and Eastern Europe.

companies.name: Rodemco LTD.
companies.quote: Mr. Izaki is also the Chairman of the Board and the largest shareholder in, Rodemco LTD., a public company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

companies.name: IGI- IZAKI GROUP USA
companies.quote: Eldad Blaustein serves as the CEO for IGI- IZAKI GROUP USA and oversees all operation in the US.

companies.name: REVAIA LTD
companies.quote: Prior to setting the US operation for the IGI- IZAKI GROUP USA, Mr. Blaustein served as the Executive V.P of REVAIA LTD, an Israeli development company and heads the IGI GROUP operations.
